snap_zoom_in.name: Snap Zoom In (High Impact)
snap_zoom_in.best_for: Auto-punch in on face or key talking point

spring_overshoot.name: Spring Bounce Overshoot
spring_overshoot.best_for: Sticker pop-ins, emojis, badge reveals, like buttons

cinematic_slow_creep.name: Cinematic Slow Creep Zoom
cinematic_slow_creep.best_for: Subtle 108% slow push-in during long sentences to maintain retention

impact_shake_decay.name: Exponential Impact Shake Decay
impact_shake_decay.python_formula: lambda t, freq=24.0, decay=6.0: math.sin(t * freq * 2 * math.pi) * math.exp(-t * decay)
impact_shake_decay.best_for: Screen shake after meme bass drop or punchy word
